name: Sacchin
message: 「Believe it or not, they say today is my birthday!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aww, so you already knew. Knowing something even I didn't know is amazing!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, then I won't hold back! Digging in!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hoho? There are candles stuck in it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh, do I have to blow out the candles? Even though I don't have much lung capacity...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it be... because it's my birthday?」
